source: the consumer's own trace (SN8K.app bridge, HopTracer stage ax_witness), read off the operator's desk; uuids are the plug-in's own instance identifiers and carry no track or project name
consumer: SN8K.app 0.x (AUv3 host application) linking LogicProMCPKit pinned at e01c8e8c on the sn8k/library-product lineage; the census walked through AXPluginInstanceIdentity.census(pluginName: "SN8K", identifierPrefix: "sn8k.instance:") every 2 s
reads_from: an unsandboxed container application (com.trojantech.SN8K), not the AUv3 extension; Accessibility granted
logic_project: 23 audio tracks, Mixer docked in the main window (X), header All, six SN8K instances on six non-contiguous strips, six editor windows open

census_summary_line.line: census ok strips=6 windows=6 uuids=6 whole=true trusted=true mixer=true
census_summary_line.read_by: maintainer of the consumer, from the operator's desk

pass_line.read_by: maintainer of the consumer, from the operator's desk

identifier_probe.method: direct AX walk of each AXDialog window from a trusted shell process
identifier_probe.result: six editor windows, each carrying exactly one descendant kAXIdentifier with the sn8k.instance: prefix, two hits per window (the hosting view and the controller view carry the same string)
identifier_probe.note: 8-character prefixes of the uuids as stamped at that time; the six above are the restored instance uuids stamped after the fix to the view side

window_titles.observation: the AX title of every editor window equalled the hosting strip's name field to the character, including a 41-character track name; no plug-in name suffix

slot_labels.observation: an occupied insert slot whose Audio Unit component is named SN8KExtension carries the AX description SN8KExtens
